checks: New extraction prepares and collects once then clears metadata
Same turn repeated clicks cannot dispatch multiple mutations
Unknown collection response keeps intent and disables fresh generation
Reload metadata recovers by GET and never automatically POSTs
Explicit resume uses saved project and count without creating again
Cancel a recovered operation clears only after server confirms terminal
Unknown response later recovers committed result via GET only
Actor switch aborts old collection and excludes late private result
scope: Actual mounted Tool under StrictMode and actual bounded transport/persistence; JSDOM storage, synthetic network and lock scheduler. Not native Web Locks, actual browser, API integration or production evidence.
